Solvent Gangrene This concoction creates a wonderful fungal rash on the flesh of the victim thus slowly eating it away. My second concoction requires one BUNDLE OF WORMWOOD, one pinch of GRAVE MOLD, one bit of DARKBONE MARROW, a LINED POISON VIAL and CONSTRICT SUSPENSION. Visceral Rot My final concoction is a favorite in the mines of malfunction. It causes the longest lasting rotting of the flesh. The ingredients required are one pinch of GRAVE MOLD, one bit of DARKBONE MARROW, WOOD ROSE, a SEALED POISON VIAL and LARENT SUSPENTION. }} [[Category:Vendor Sold]] [[Category:Book]]
